chunks: The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, when he bade farewell to the believers, would say:
May Allah provide you with taqwa, direct you to every good, fulfill for you every need, keep safe for you your religion and your worldly life, and return you safely to those who are safe.

key_terms.حَاجَةٍ: need; any personal need or requirement
key_terms.خَيْرٍ: goodness; all forms of benefit and virtue
key_terms.دُنْيَاكُمْ: your worldly life; your worldly affairs and well-being
key_terms.دِينَكُمْ: your religion; your faith and religious state
key_terms.سَالِمِينَ: safe and sound; protected from harm
key_terms.ٱلتَّقْوَى: taqwa; God-conscious piety and spiritual protection

ai.seo_question: What did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم say when bidding farewell to the believers?
ai.summary: This hadith records a farewell supplication of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم for the believers. It asks Allah to grant taqwa, guidance to goodness, fulfillment of needs, protection in religion and worldly life, and a safe return.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2429 - When the Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace and blessings of Allah (swt) be upon him and his family) bid farewell to the believers, he would say:
"May Allah (swt) provide you with piety, direct you toward all that is good, fulfill all your needs, safeguard your religion and your worldly affairs, and return you safely to your loved ones."
